dct_description_sm: The main objective of this effort is to: 1. Collect and assess a long-term data set on the nesting biology of all avifauna in the Prudhoe Bay region focusing on key nesting biology parameters including nest density, nest survivorship, and nest initiation date. 2. Assess general activity levels and presence of potential nest predators. 3. Measure other factors that may influence nest survivorship including habitat characteristics, snow cover, temperature, and lemming abundance. 4. Accurately identify nest predators at active nests using remote camera systems. This data set is being used to help better understand potential impacts to nesting birds from industry (by comparing these results to other sites on the North Slope where comparable data is collected) and in assessing the influence of climate change by examining long-term trends.
dct_title_s: Nesting success and nest predators of tundra-nesting birds in the Prudhoe Bay Oilfield, Alaska
